description: This file defines the class DittoAuthorizationContextType, which specifies particular authorization context types used in the Ditto project, including constants for different kinds of authorization mechanisms such as JWT, pre-authenticated HTTP, and connection-based methods.

classes.name: DittoAuthorizationContextType
classes.description: A final class representing specific built-in authorization context types in Ditto, extending AuthorizationContextType and providing predefined constants and utility methods to check and retrieve these types.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an array of all predefined Ditto authorization context types.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether a given AuthorizationContextType is one of the predefined Ditto types.
